3967-7084-8337.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, M'Ress triggers, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

4279-5931-7316--216.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5931-7316--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1479-2841-7889-8103.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-7889-8103.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3899-6761-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Scouring Swarm trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Scouring Swarm trigger, untapping it and creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.
3899-6761-7084.notes: If you have seven or more land cards in your graveyard, this combo can create infinite creature tokens if you start it with two or more Scouring Swarms.

2719-4247-5756.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

1808-3000-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4772-5478-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
4094-4772-5478-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

856-4321-5256-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-5256-7396.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1445-4871-6797-7396.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-6797-7396.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with X or more charge counters on it

198-2341-2495.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Empowered Autogenerator and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Empowered Autogenerator and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Empowered Autogenerator and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

3693-5220-6247.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and High-Society Hunter.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Walking Ballista from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Walking Ballista from your library.
Repeat.

997-4112-4375.description:
Cast Sharuum either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{W}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Technomancer.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Technomancer.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2457-2557-6633.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1718-3327-4613-5961.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1718-3327-4613-5961.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest.
Activate Dargo using Catalyst Elemental's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

1545-3490-5231-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
1545-3490-5231-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Trostani indestructible.
1545-3490-5231-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1-1742-2498-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-1742-2498-6282.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

2187-5195-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying {U}, targeting Possessed Skaab
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Possessed Skaab
When Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Splash Portal to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1069-1256-1322-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1256-1322-5499.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1413-2178-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Thraben Doomsayer does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Thraben Doomsayer.
1413-2178-4050.description:
Activate Thraben Doomsayer by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Human, adding one mana of any color.
When the Human dies, Thraben Doomsayer triggers, untapping Thraben Doomsayer.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Alara // Awaken the Maelstrom

111-141.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
111-141.notablePrerequisites: You are able to defeat Invasion of Alara.
111-141.description:
Defeat Invasion of Alara, triggering it, causing you to exile it and cast Awaken the Maelstrom.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Awaken the Maelstrom, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Maelstrom, causing a player to draw two cards, then allowing you to put an artifact card from your hand onto the battlefield, then creating a token copy of Naru Meha, then putting three +1/+1 counters on creature(s) you control, and then destroying a permanent an opponent controls.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

3156-3652-3661-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Ornithopter, targeting Shield Sphere.
When Ornithopter dies, Koll triggers, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Shield Sphere.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Shield Sphere, targeting Ornithopter.
When Shield Sphere dies, Koll triggers, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Ornithopter.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2092-2757-4038.notablePrerequisites:
Farmstead Gleaner does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
You control at least one basic land.
2092-2757-4038.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Farmstead Gleaner, untapping the basic land.
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1558-2719-2740-4231.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Tamiyo's Journal triggers, creating three Food, three Clue, and three Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2086-4050-4419.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks, adding one mana of any color.
Kitchen Finks' persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with zero -1/-1 counters on it due to Renata.
Kitchen Finks entering the battlefield, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

1218-1972-5280.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U}{B} if each opponent has three or more poison counters, or {6}{U}{U}{U}{B} otherwise
1218-1972-5280.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Nekusar +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Echo of Eons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Nekusar triggers for each card your opponents draw.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to get a poison counter.
If the opponent has ten or more poison counters, they lose the game as a state-based action.
Repeat from step 4 for each remaining trigger.
If needed, cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Repeat from step 3.
